info.title: E2E fixture register
info.description: A destination for the landing-page form fixture (tests/e2e/site-form-submission.spec.ts). Stands in for the register of the app that asked for the page, such as a CRM's lead. Never shipped: only tests/e2e/fixtures/seed-cms.sh imports it.

x-openregister.description: E2E fixture: the object a landing-page form creates.

signup.title: Sign-up
signup.description: What a visitor's submit of the fixture form creates, in the visitor's own request (decision 179). The public may create one, as a CRM lets the public create a lead; only an administrator reads it.

email.title: Email
email.description: The email address the visitor typed.

source.title: Source
source.description: Fixed by the form: where this sign-up came from.

formId.title: Form
formId.description: Written by the page, never by an answer: the form that was submitted.

pageRoute.title: Page route
pageRoute.description: Written by the page: the route of the page that hosts the form.

portal.title: Portal
portal.description: Written by the page: the portal the page belongs to.

submittedAt.title: Submitted at
submittedAt.description: Written by the page: when the visitor sent the form.

nonce.title: Submission id
nonce.description: Written by the page: its own id for this submission.

utmFirstTouch.title: First touch
utmFirstTouch.description: The campaign parameters of the visitor's first visit.

utmLastTouch.title: Last touch
utmLastTouch.description: The campaign parameters of the visit the form was sent on.

referrer.title: Referrer
referrer.description: The page the visitor came from.
